# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P18](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0018), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat, stolid youth with a round, freckled, expressionless face and broad features. He is well known for his perpetual, broad grin.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c8 P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Billy is a quiet, good-natured, and exceptionally shy young man who suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts. He is a hard, dependable worker without bad habits, though he tends to be somewhat slow and lacks initiative.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v4 c39 P7](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0007)_

## History

Billy Andrews grew up in Avonlea as part of the large Andrews connection. During his youth he attended local events, including driving Anne Shirley, Jane Andrews, and Diana Barry to a concert at the White Sands Hotel, where his extreme shyness kept him mostly silent. He held a long-standing admiration for Anne Shirley, and when his father offered to deed him the family's upper farm upon his marriage, he attempted to propose to her. Too timid to speak for himself, he enlisted his sister Jane to propose to Anne on his behalf. After Anne rejected the proposal, Billy turned his attentions to Nettie Blewett, whom he married the following year. The couple subsequently 'appeared out' together at the Avonlea church to the great pride of the Andrews family.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v1 c33 P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 c8 P23](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0023), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v4 c1 P27](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0027)_
